referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 kilowatt hour of electricity in a residence, by hydrogen conversion in a fuel cell, PEM. The hydrogen is produced by Steam Methane Reforming, with CCS, with liquefied natural gas from Algeria as feedstock. Electricity conversion efficiency [% LHV input]: 45%. LHV [kWh/kg]: 33.33. Market price [Euro/MJ]: 0.03. Synthesis efficiency [% LHV input]: 0%. Total cap. Input-related [kW]: 2.74. CO2 biogenic share [%]: 0%. Power [kW]: 1.6. Lifetime [years]: 4.88. Annual operation [hours]: 4100. Allocation factor: 0.88. On-site storage loss [%]: 0. Use loss [%]: 0.56. For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
